title: Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate
overview: As a candidate for this certification, you should have subject matter expertise in implementing, managing, and monitoring an organization’s Microsoft Azure environment, including virtual networks, storage, compute, identity, security, and governance.
eligibility: None strictly required. Prior knowledge of Microsoft cloud technologies recommended.
exam_format_type: Multiple choice, case studies, and performance-based labs
testing_method: Pearson VUE testing center or online proctored
